documents.text: the early years of the reign of Charles I the Belasyse family sided with Sir John Savile , the custos rotulorum of the West Riding , against Sir Thomas Wentworth . The Savile 's allied themselves with the Duke of Buckingham and it may have been through this political connection that on 25 May 1627 that Belasyse was raised to the peerage as Lord Fauconberg of Yarm . [ 3 ] [ 4 ] After the assassination of Buckingham , Wentworth 's influence at court grew and with it his power , while that of his political opponents Yorkshire waned
